Environmental restoration projects began on Adak under the Navy Assessment and Control of Installation Pollutants program with an initial assessment study (IAS) in 1986. The IAS identified

. In 1988, site inspections were conducted at areas identified in the IAS. In 1989, an RCRA facility assessment (RFA) was completed by the EPA under the RCRA corrective action program. Adak was proposed for the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) National Priorities List in October 1992, and it was officially placed on the NPL in May 1994.
